speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To better assess your condition, how many days have passed since you finished your antibiotics, and what specific antibiotics were you prescribed?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to recent antibiotic therapy. The symptoms of fatigue, flank pain, and fever following treatment for sinusitis are classic signs of ascending urinary tract infection or drug-induced interstitial nephritis. I will confirm this with a urinalysis and blood work. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, CBC, BMP, Blood Cultures.
